description.value:
Your inner cosmo is a wellspring of power you can spend. You gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point and the Refocus activity; you can Refocus by burning your cosmo for 10 minutes.

Your Techniques are focus spells with the cosmo trait. They use your Cosmo DC and your key ability, and their rank is equal to half your level rounded up.

Your focus pool increases to 2 points at 7th level and 3 points at 15th level.

To regain Focus Points, see the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Refocus] action.
